name: Black Bean & Veggie Quesadillas with Tomato & Avocado Salsa

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry tomatoes, jalapeños, and cilantro.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice and transfer tomatoes to a large bowl. Seed, mince, and add ½ of the jalapeños to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling). Halve and pit avocados; scoop out the flesh, medium dice, and add to bowl. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add ½ to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling). Peel, small dice onions, and add ½ to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling).
Drizzle ingredients in bowl with olive oil and lime juice; season with salt and pepper. Mix to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tsp extra virgin olive oil
juice of 1 ½ limes
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash, seed, and small dice bell peppers.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add remaining onion, jalapeño, and bell pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables have softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add beans and remaining cilantro to skillet. Then season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook until beans are warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry skillet. Heat over medium heat.
Place tortillas on a flat surface. Layer one half of each tortilla with ⅛ of the cheese, ¼ of the bean mixture, and another ⅛ of the cheese. Fold tortillas over to close.

Coat skillet with oil. Place 2 of the quesadillas in the skillet, straight edges next to each other. Cook until golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes per side. Repeat with remaining quesadillas.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Transfer to a cutting board and cut into wedges.
To serve, place quesadilla on a plate and serve with salsa. Enjoy!
